  path={"/api/v0/users/{userId}/roles/{roleId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Removes the role from the user, whether it was granted for this convention or globally. Roles that an automated process manages can't be removed.

### Authentication

This endpoint requires the `user:roles:update` scope.
